services.name: Guided Side-By-Side Tours
services.desc: Experience Northern Michigan’s Premier Off-Roading Adventure! Discover the thrill of off-roading with our Guided Side-by-Side Tours at Indian River—Northern Michigan’s top adventure destination! Ride through scenic trails featuring rolling hills, majestic forests, and a pristine lake. Our trails offer stunning scenery year-round, from spring’s blooming trilliums to autumn’s vibrant colors. Perfect for couples, families, and groups of all experience levels! Tour Options 1.5-Hour Scenic Trail Ride Ideal for a shorter adventure, this tour allows you to explore a variety of beautiful trails and 1.5 or 2.5 Hours • Ages 5+ to Ride • Ages 16+ to Drive • Advanced Reservations Recommended

services.name: Raft Trips
services.desc: Water Rafting Trip About Experience the ultimate in stability and family/group adventure with our 5-person and 7-person rafts, crafted from extremely durable Hypalon. These rafts are the same as those used on major whitewater rivers (without the whitewater) and are nearly impossible to tip over. It is up to you and your group to navigate through narrow passages and around obstacles. Promoting teamwork these are great for families and groups. > Note: This is NOT a lazy river—you'll need to watch where you're going, paddle and work together as a team, and push away from logs and sticks. This All Ages! • 1-4 Hours

services.name: Tube Trips
services.desc: Adventure Down the River in a Tube! About Looking for the perfect way to spend a hot, sunny afternoon in beautiful Northern Michigan? Adventure down the clear, refreshing Sturgeon River in a tube! River Tubing is a wet and incredibly fun group experience. > Note: This is NOT a lazy river—you'll need to watch where you're going, paddle occasionally, and push away from logs and sticks. This adds to the excitement for those with an adventurous spirit! Tubing is best enjoyed on sunny days with temperatures of at least 70 degrees. > Please Note: Tubes move slower than rafts, so a 2-hour raft trip Ages 6+ • 1.5 & 2.5 Hours

services.name: Tube Tracker Trips
services.desc: Inflatable, Steerable Kayak-Tube Try our hybrid, inflatable, and steerable Kayak-Tubes! They have the comfort of a tube with the control of a kayak. Tube Trackers are perfect for the fast flow of the Sturgeon River and for those who want more control than a tube, but a more casual ride than traditional kayaking. Featuring 3 heavy-duty fins on the abrasion-resistant bottom, these allow some water to enter and circulate helping to prevent overturn in even whitewater conditions. > Note: This is NOT a lazy river—you'll need to watch where you're going, paddle, and push away from logs and sticks. Ages 10+ • 1 & 2 Hours

services.name: Solo and Tandem Kayak Trips
services.desc: Paddle down the river in a kayak! About The Sturgeon River is not a lazy river—it’s fast and thrilling! Perfect for adventurous paddlers ready to take on the challenge, our solo and tandem “Sit-On-Top” Kayaks are designed to handle the swift currents and potential tip-overs without filling with water like traditional canoes or sit-in kayaks (which can be extremely difficult/heavy to stop, catch, and empty the water out). > Note: This is NOT a lazy river—you'll need to watch where you're going, paddle, and push away from logs and sticks. services.name: Challenging Mid-Section Kayak Trip • Rondo to N. White Road
services.desc: Challenging Mid Section Trip About We offer a "Mid-Section" trip for those who want the faster, most challenging part of the river, but don't necessarily want or have the time to do the Wolverine (5 hr.) trip, and/or wouldn't mind skipping the last 1 1/2 hrs. of the river (which is the easier section, has more homes/cottages, and at peak times more congested with rafts and tubes). This trip ends at N. White Rd, the most commonly used put-in point (which we own), and is definitely for more advanced paddlers! You are responsible for any lost, stolen, or damaged Ages 14+ • 2-2.5 Hours
